cases.name: Shanika Gladney
cases.about: Her niece Sha’nariah Grice, told WINK News that Gladney had been killed.“She just was a good person, you know. She never really… and no drama, nothing, none of that stuff that she was in, so I just don’t understand what happened and why it had to happen,” Grice said at the time. “I just love her, Imma always love and miss my auntie, and that’s always gonna be my favorite aunt.”
